title: Kiln Artifact Lifecycle API
description: Request and response shapes for listing, uploading, merging, loading, unloading, and deleting adapters; creating or deleting immutable HF/TRL exports; importing verified PEFT results; and managing teacher identities. Start with the entrypoint for your HTTP operation, then open only the definitions it references. Deletion is permanent, live adapters must be unloaded before deletion, generic upload does not provide verified HF/TRL provenance, and remote teacher registration currently supports only vLLM. Unknown-field behavior is listed per shape. The x-kiln-examples use explicit CPU and placeholder build identities so they remain illustrative payloads, not hardware receipts or backend support claims.
x-kiln-example-boundary: Illustrative payloads only. Example backend and build values are not runtime defaults, support predicates, qualification evidence, or benchmark receipts.

AdapterCanaryCheckReceipt.description: Outcome of one adapter canary or smoke check.

AdapterCanaryStatus.description: Result of the adapter's latest recorded canary check.

AdapterDetail.description: Adapter files plus the training, evaluation, and lineage evidence Kiln still retains.

AdapterDiskEntry.description: One adapter directory discovered by Kiln, including directories it classifies as invalid or quarantined.

AdapterFileEntry.description: One regular file stored in an adapter directory.

AdapterLinkedEval.description: Retained summary of an evaluation linked to the adapter.

AdapterLinkedJob.description: Retained summary of a training job that produced or used the adapter.

AdapterManifest.description: Content, lineage, model, and training identity recorded for an installed adapter.

AdapterManifestFiles.description: Canonical adapter filenames bound by the manifest.

AdapterName.x-kiln-runtime-footgun: adapter names currently have no byte limit or control-character restriction
AdapterName.description: An adapter registry name: non-empty, relative, not dot-prefixed, and without separators or `..`. The generic adapter routes currently impose no byte limit or control-character restriction.

AdapterRegistryStatus.description: How Kiln currently classifies an adapter directory.

AdapterUploadMultipart.description: Generic multipart adapter upload. This route validates archive safety and adapter files but does not provide the HF/TRL export/result identity checks; use verified PEFT import for that handoff. Unknown multipart fields are consumed and ignored.

AdaptersResponse.description: Current live-adapter identity and all adapter directories visible to the server.

AgenticGroup.description: One prompt and 2–1,024 provenance-complete scored rollouts. `rollouts` is an input alias for `completions`.

AnyJson.description: Any valid JSON value; Kiln does not interpret its nested fields here.

DeleteAdapterResponse.description: Confirmation of permanent adapter deletion. The route refuses a live or active adapter and also removes matching `<name>-checkpoint-*` directories.

DeleteExportResponse.description: Confirmation that the server copy of an immutable export was permanently deleted.

DeleteTeacherResponse.description: Confirmation that a teacher alias was removed from the registry. Existing adapter receipts are unchanged.

DiagnosticSummary.description: High-level diagnostics retained after an adapter training run.

EchoDiagnosticSummary.description: ECHO measurements retained in an adapter receipt.

ExportDetail.description: One export summary and its complete self-verifying manifest.

ExportList.description: All immutable HF/TRL exports currently retained by the server.

ExportName.description: A server-owned HF/TRL export name: 1–128 ASCII characters, beginning with a letter or number and containing only letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.

ExportSummary.description: List-view identity and download path for one immutable HF/TRL export.

GrpoExportRequest.description: Create an immutable recorded-GRPO handoff from exactly one source: inline groups or a canonical server-local JSONL file.

HfTrlDataExport.description: Dataset file identity and either SFT selection evidence or the recorded-GRPO provenance contract.

x-kiln-semantic-constraints: export_sha256 matches the canonical manifest digest
HfTrlExportManifestV1.description: Self-verifying identity of one immutable Kiln-to-HF/TRL export directory.

HfTrlFileIdentity.description: Relative path, byte length, and SHA-256 identity for one regular file in an interoperability bundle.

HfTrlInputAdapter.description: Optional input adapter copied into the bundle with its exact configuration and weights.

HfTrlModelIdentity.description: Resident model, tokenizer, and template identities the external trainer must match.

HfTrlSftLabelPolicy.description: How the exported SFT template selects labels.

HfTrlSftSelection.description: SFT admission counts, row policy, corpus digest, and ingestion-receipt identity.

ImportAdapterName.description: A path-safe adapter name accepted by verified HF/TRL PEFT import: 1–128 ASCII characters with no consecutive periods.

ImportPeftResponse.description: Identity and size of a verified external PEFT result installed as six files in Kiln's adapter registry.

LoadAdapterRequest.description: Load an installed adapter between requests. `allow_quarantined` explicitly overrides canary quarantine; `reload` re-reads and republishes the exact on-disk revision even when that adapter name is already live.

LoadAdapterResponse.description: Confirmation that the named adapter revision is live.

LoadedAdapterIdentity.description: Adapter name and immutable content revision currently published by the live model runner.

LogitSourceCaps.description: Scoring capabilities Kiln resolved from a teacher source.

MergeAdapterRequest.description: Create a new merged adapter without replacing an existing name. `density` applies only to TIES and defaults to 0.2 for that mode.

MergeAdapterResponse.description: Summary of the newly published merged adapter.

MergeMode.description: Algorithm used to merge source adapters.

MergeSource.description: One source adapter and its merge weight.

MergeSourceInfo.description: One source adapter recorded in the merge result.

NonEmptyString.description: A text string containing at least one character.

NonNegativeInteger.description: A whole number greater than or equal to zero.

PositiveInteger.description: A whole number greater than or equal to one.

PromptSourceDescriptor.description: Source, manifest digest, and row count for the prompts used by training.

RegisterTeacherRequest.description: Fields callers may set when registering a teacher. Kiln rejects caller-supplied identity, capabilities, and secret environment-variable names.

RemoteProvider.description: Remote scoring protocol identifier. The schema retains compatibility values, but teacher registration currently accepts only `vllm`.

ScoredRollout.description: One reward-scored completion with optional trajectory and generation provenance.

SftExample.description: One conversation submitted for supervised fine-tuning.

SftExportRequest.description: Create an immutable SFT handoff from exactly one source: inline examples, a server-local file, or a registered dataset.

SftInvalidRowPolicy.description: Whether an invalid SFT row rejects the export or is skipped and recorded.

Sha256.description: A lowercase SHA-256 digest prefixed with `sha256:`.

TeacherAdapterIdentityV1.description: Exact static adapter identity served with a teacher model.

TeacherDescriptor.description: Teacher identity retained by a legacy adapter receipt.

TeacherEntry.description: Stored teacher configuration plus its resolved identity, capabilities, and current usability.

TeacherIdentityV1.description: Model, tokenizer, adapter, protocol, and serving-capability identity pinned during teacher registration.

TeacherSpec.description: Stored teacher configuration. Kiln derives identity and capability claims instead of accepting them from this object.

TeachersListResponse.description: All teachers currently stored in the server registry.

TrainingChatMessage.description: A chat message accepted for export. Text content parts are concatenated; non-text parts are ignored.

TrainingCheckpointPrecision.description: The exact precision policy recorded by a native training checkpoint.

TrainingJobType.description: The native training workflow that produced a linked job.

TrainingState.description: Training-job lifecycle state. Cancelled training jobs are represented as `failed` with a cancellation error.

TurnKind.description: The supervision role of one trajectory segment.

TurnSegment.description: One context, action, or observation segment in an agentic rollout.

UnitInterval.description: A merge density greater than 0 and no greater than 1.

UnloadAdapterResponse.description: Confirmation that no runtime adapter is loaded.

UploadAdapterResponse.description: Summary of an adapter archive installed without replacing an existing directory.

kiln_train_AdapterReceipt.description: Legacy adapter audit receipt. It records useful provenance and diagnostics but does not contain enough identity for exact replay.
